meta.title: Report on 2 fields of Fazenda Boa Vista
meta.subtitle: Imagery 2025-09-27 to 2026-09-19 and 2025-09-25 to 2026-09-25
meta.author: J. Leonardi

question: Which fields departed this season?
summary: Across 2 fields, 249.5 ha were classified into 2 classes; the largest, Soybean, covers 96.6% of it.
NDVI peaks fall between 2025-12-20 and 2025-12-20 in the 2 fields with a season.
On its latest date with a reference, NDVI is at least one standard deviation below the field's earlier seasons in 1 of 2 fields, and at least two below in 1 (field 7).
Public registers other than CAR meet 2 fields: PRODES clearing after 22 Jul 2008, 3.0 ha over 2 fields. Not read: Conservation units.
The Sentinel-1 series records at least one canopy loss in 1 of 1 fields.
The suggested number of management zones is 3 in 2 fields.

sections.title: Acquisition
lines: Sentinel-2 L2A through the Planetary Computer STAC catalogue
scenes under the cloud ceiling set for the run (not recorded with it)
one scene per month or every scene under the ceiling, as the run was set (not recorded with it)
bands read over /vsicurl: only the polygon window, only the bands the model needs

sections.title: Features
lines: B02, B03, B04 and B08 at 10 m, reflectance scaled by 1/10000
NDVI, EVI and SAVI per date
14 temporal statistics per index: mean, sd, max, min, amplitude, median, index of peak and of trough, first- and second-half means and their difference, mean change, largest rise, largest fall
4 statistics per raw band, and the 22 raw NDVI dates
80 features per pixel
sections.note: A pixel is kept only where at least half its dates are non-zero. Remaining gaps are filled by linear interpolation along time, so a cloud-masked date is inferred rather than dropped.

sections.title: Model
lines: Random forest, 300 trees, maximum depth 20
features standardised by the scaler fitted at training

sections.title: Output
lines: 5 MapBiomas classes: 3, 21, 25, 39, 41
confidence: the largest class probability

method.subtitle: NDVI and NDRE against the same days of earlier seasons

sections.title: Acquisition
lines: Sentinel-2 L2A, B04 B08 at 10 m and B05 B8A at 20 m, from the Planetary Computer
every acquisition from 2025-09-25 to 2026-09-25 under the scene cloud ceiling set for the run (not recorded with it), and the same days of the three seasons before
per acquisition, the cells its scene classification calls clear; one under 30% of the area clear is not counted
reflectance with the 04.00 offset removed; NDVI (B08, B04) and NDRE (B8A, B05) averaged over the clear cells

sections.title: Comparison
lines: each date against the earlier seasons' dates within 16 days of the same day of the year
departure (x - mean) / sd, the sd floored at 0.02; none with fewer than two earlier dates
a map of the latest date at least 60% clear: its NDVI minus the median of the earlier seasons around that day, per cell
in the compositor, the fields of a set can also be compared with each other on a date they share
sections.note: NDRE beside NDVI because NDVI saturates over a closed canopy, where the red edge still moves with chlorophyll (Gitelson and Merzlyak, 1994).

sections.title: Reading
lines: one and two standard deviations are the cuts between typical, below and well below
sections.note: A departure is not a diagnosis: a later sowing, another crop or a fallow field departs as a stressed one does. Earlier seasons of another crop in rotation widen or shift the reference.

tables.caption: The number of zones that ranks best on the fuzziness performance index (FPI) and the normalised classification entropy (NCE) together; lower values of both separate more clearly.

limitations.label: Resolution
limitations.text: Sentinel-2 cells are 10 m (0.01 ha). A field's edge cells mix the field with what surrounds it.

limitations.label: Confidence
limitations.text: Confidence is the probability the classifier gave its chosen class. A confidence of 0.67 does not mean 67% of such pixels are correct.

limitations.label: Season dates
limitations.text: NDVI marks emergence and senescence, not sowing and harvest. Each date lies between the clear observations around it, and cloud widens that window.

limitations.label: Departure
limitations.text: A departure is not a diagnosis: a later sowing, another crop or a fallow field departs as a stressed one does. Earlier seasons of another crop in rotation shift the reference.

limitations.label: Registers
limitations.text: The registers hold for the moment they were read. An overlap is not a finding of irregularity: a clearing can be authorised, an embargo lifted after publication. APP and legal-reserve polygons are not published by WFS and are not read.

limitations.label: Radar thresholds
limitations.text: The canopy-loss rule (VH drop of 3 dB, cross-ratio drop of 1 dB) and the water rule (VH below −23 dB and VV below −13 dB) are fixed, and were not calibrated against harvest records.

limitations.label: Zones
limitations.text: The zones show where the canopy differed across seasons, not why: soil, drainage, compaction or a past management line draw the same boundary.

limitations.label: Field verification
limitations.text: No figure in this report was verified on the ground by TERRA.
